title: What Is TSMC? The Complete History of Morris Chang and the Foundry That Makes Everything (2026)
summary: TSMC history: Morris Chang, the 1987 pure-play foundry bet, yield as chipmaking's master metric, and why a single company makes about 90% of leading-edge logic.
body_markdown:
```text
RESERVED SLICE vs SHARED POOL — the same fab, two contracts    Joint venture:   customer buys 20% of the fab  →  gets 20% of capacity                      customer grows 5x in one year →  needs 100%                      result: STRANDED at 20%, and the fab cannot help
Shared pool:     customer buys nothing         →  gets what it needs                      fab reinvests all profit into capacity                      result: "we satisfied most of our customers, and we                               PLEASED all of our important customers —                               those that grew very fast"
The lesson: when customer growth rates are widely dispersed, a shared     flexible pool beats reserved slices FOR BOTH SIDES. The reservation     protects you from the scenario you should be hoping for.
```
